summary: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing that its board of directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.77 per share on its common stock. The dividend is payable November 13, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 23, 2026. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation event, transaction, stake, or strategic action is present; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration and does not warrant event-driven classification.
